description: Browse Verdict's DeFi ratings for one entity type, optionally filtered by category or chain. Returns entities with their letter grade + composite score, best-rated first. Example: list_ratings({ entity_type: 'protocol', category: 'lending' }).

chain.description: Optional chain filter by chain slug, e.g. 'ethereum' or 'base'.

entity_type.description: The kind of entity to browse: protocol, chain, token, oracle, vault, organisation, or bridge.

name: list_ratings
title: List / browse Verdict ratings
